name: openlunum-workspace
description: OpenLunum: language-neutral semantics, model-aware rendering, local-model evaluation, and product adoption contracts.

scripts.test: pnpm build && pnpm -r --sort test:unit && pnpm test:merge-policy && pnpm test:quality-gate-runner && pnpm test:worker-dispatch && pnpm test:nightly-window && pnpm test:verify-audit-endpoints
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm eval:smoke
scripts.verify:strict: pnpm build && pnpm -r --sort typecheck && pnpm -r --sort test:unit && pnpm eval:smoke && pnpm --filter @corpunum/lunum-eval verify:strict
